scope: The 70 government contributions by 47 reviewed people in the 447-contribution analytic sample, and matching speech IDs in the candidate and validation-sample files. Other candidate records are outside this review.
method: Match the contribution date to the dated primary ministerial or state-secretary office in Parlement.com, and review the party history at that date. Party affiliation does not imply speaking for a parliamentary party. Roles, identities, texts, coding, inclusion and ordering are unchanged. Dutch office titles give the primary portfolio; English capacities are editorial translations. Detailed delegated responsibilities and additional deputy-premier offices are not an exhaustive part of this metadata.
date_convention: ISO dates copied from Parlement.com: office start inclusive, departure date exclusive. No reviewed speech falls exactly on a departure date. A continuous same-portfolio term can span multiple cabinets.
